report.disclaimer: This report was generated by an AI system from an automated image classifier. It is not a diagnosis and must not be used on its own to make clinical decisions. A qualified clinician must review the image and the patient's clinical findings.
limitations: The model was evaluated on data from two public datasets where each disease came from a different source.
Grad-CAM reflects model attention across an approximate 3x2 grid rather than verified anatomical lung boundaries.
Attention was diffuse across the scan, and visual features alone cannot confirm an underlying cause as other conditions can appear similar.
report.recommendation: A clinician should correlate the image with symptoms, examination, and, where appropriate, laboratory tests before deciding on treatment.
report.summary: The AI classifier evaluated the chest X-ray and identified patterns consistent with pneumonia with high confidence. Model attention was diffuse across the image, with the greatest influence observed around the coarse right upper zone. This finding represents AI visual pattern detection rather than a confirmed medical diagnosis.
